findings.title: The two-work capacity checker ignores the actual claim predicate.

mutation.before: hết M ← lần_nhận >= M ; quá hạn ← quá_hạn_gốc ; hết chỗ ← not còn_chỗ ; được ← True
mutation.after: hết M ← lần_nhận >= M ; quá hạn ← quá_hạn_gốc ; hết chỗ ← False ; được ← True

findings.limitation: All 17 graphs were NOT rerun. The unchanged True field makes this predicate mutation inert within their generated inputs. The direct false-capacity probe demonstrates the missing case.
findings.fix: Run both jobs through the real claim classifier/actions over one shared capacity value; test stale capacity reads, full capacity, atomic claim and release.

findings.fix: Separate expected invalid-spec rejection from an internal checker exception. Unexpected exceptions are ERROR/INCONCLUSIVE, never evidence that a safety defect was detected.

scope: Local source/unit probes only; no PG, Flow, remote writes, or exhaustive 17-scenario run.
